items.title: Best Practices for Many-To-One and One-To-Many Association Mappings
items.description: Detailed guide and senior deep dive into JPA/Hibernate best practices for @ManyToOne and @OneToMany mappings based on Thorben Janssen's tutorial.

items.title: Bloom Filters
items.description: Probabilistic data structure for efficient membership testing with O(1) lookup time, constant space usage, and controlled false positive rates. Covers implementation, use cases, Java examples, and interview patterns.

items.title: Caching Strategies
items.description: A complete guide to caching — from beginner fundamentals to senior-level cache architecture. Covers all patterns, eviction policies, Redis deep dive, invalidation strategies, failure modes, and how to decide which strategy to use.

items.title: Caching Strategies
items.description: In-depth guide to caching strategies including cache-aside, write-through, write-behind, eviction policies, cache stampede prevention, hotkeys, Redis data structures, and multi-level caching.

items.title: CPU Scheduling
items.description: CPU scheduling algorithms, metrics, multilevel queues, real-time scheduling, and how the Linux CFS scheduler works.

items.title: Database Indexing: A Senior Engineer's Deep Dive
items.description: An advanced, comprehensive guide to database indexing mechanisms, covering Disk I/O, B-Trees, Hash Indexes, Geospatial (Geohashing, R-trees), and Inverted Indexes for System Design.

items.title: Hibernate Transactions and Performance in Spring Apps
items.description: Deep dive into Hibernate transaction semantics, locking, N+1 diagnostics, and performance tuning in Spring applications.

items.title: Indexing & Query Optimization
items.description: Deep dive into database indexes — B-Tree, hash, covering, composite — and strategies to analyze and optimize slow queries.

items.title: Java Interview for Experienced (Part 1)
items.description: Experienced Java interview scenarios including memory behavior, HashMap resizing, and performance topics.

items.title: JPA vs Hibernate: save, persist, merge, and update
items.description: An advanced breakdown of JPA and Hibernate persistence methods, exploring entity states, primary key generation strategies, and connection pool performance.

items.title: JVM Internals: Memory, GC & Class Loading
items.description: Guide to JVM internals covering memory layout, garbage collection, class loading, and runtime performance basics.

items.title: Kafka Throughput Optimization
items.description: A deep-dive into techniques for improving Kafka throughput — covering compression, batching, partitions, consumer parallelism, tuning configs, and their trade-offs.

items.title: Network Performance & Optimization
items.description: Latency, bandwidth, throughput, connection pooling, keep-alive, HTTP/2 multiplexing, QUIC, compression, and practical tuning techniques.

items.title: Parallel Consumer Deep Dive
items.description: Deep dive into the Parallel Consumer model for increasing Kafka consumer throughput safely.

items.title: Performance & Monitoring

items.title: Redis as Distributed Cache
items.description: Distributed caching patterns with Redis — cache-aside, write-through, write-behind, read-through — and production concerns like stampede, warming, invalidation, and Spring Cache integration.

items.description: Advanced Redis patterns — distributed locking, rate limiting, session management, leaderboards, search, and production performance tuning for senior engineers.

items.title: Redis Pipeline, Transactions & Lua Scripts

items.title: Scaling Writes
items.description: Techniques for handling high write throughput including sharding, partitioning, write-ahead logging, append-only patterns, batching, and async write pipelines.

items.title: Virtual Memory Deep Dive
items.description: Address spaces, swap, OOM killer, huge pages, NUMA, and practical Linux memory tuning.
